name: Glenn Grothman
page_title: Glenn Grothman's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Republican for U.S. House (WI) - District 6

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "I commend the six Justices for making the correct and much-needed decision to overturn Roe v. Wade."
Rated 100% by National Right to Life Committee
Voted against HR 8296: "Women's Health Protection Act of 2022"
Voted in favor of HR 26: "Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act"

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Our federal government has grown to sizes our Founding Fathers likely never imagined. While many programs should be returned to the states, any Bipartisan Fiscal Commission must prioritize protecting social security for generations to come."

"The key to address our unsustainable levels of federal spending is to empower state governments, which are better equipped to carry out the goals of the lion's share of federal programs. By respecting the 10th Amendment, we can shrink gov without compromising Social Security."
Rated 0% by Alliance for Retired Americans
Rated 25% by National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "As the American people continue to face the worst inflation in 40 years, the President should focus on cutting spending and lowering taxes. Instead, he's doing the opposite."
"I am championing pro-business, pro-worker, pro-America tax reforms that will help grow both wages and the economy."
Rated 95% by National Tax Limitation Committee
Voted in favor of HR 1: "Tax Cuts and Jobs Act"

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "Had a productive meeting with the Wisconsin Fraternal Order of Police discussing their key priorities, including strengthening local/state law enforcement to combat the national epidemic of violent crime."

"The great men & women of law enforcement deserve our gratitude for their selfless work to protect us. Unfortunately, some Members of Congress continually disrespect them & their work. I honor police, especially those who gave their lives in the line of duty."
Voted against HR 1280 "George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "#WI families are struggling to afford groceries because runaway spending under @POTUS drove inflation to its highest levels since 1982. We can start making basic necessities more affordable by reeling in wasteful government spending."

"‘Bidenomics’ is crushing families as children head back to school. Since @POTUS took office, school supplies have increased by nearly 25 percent. Reckless, unchecked government spending led us here, and it is a tax on American households."
Voted against HR 5376: "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"
Voted in favor of HR 2811: "Limit, Save, Grow Act"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: Voted against HR 8294: "Transportation, Housing and Urban Development, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2023"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: Voted against HR 5376: "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

"#WI families are struggling to afford groceries because runaway spending under @POTUS drove inflation to its highest levels since 1982. We can start making basic necessities more affordable by reeling in wasteful government spending."

"As Americans' savings accounts dwindle, Washington needs to END the unchecked, unnecessary spending. When @POTUS took office, the inflation rate was 1.4 percent. Now, it's at 40-year highs. Reining in out-of-control government spending is the key to renewing our economy."

"For every dollar printed by the Federal Reserve, the dollars already in circulation lose value. I spoke on the House floor to warn my colleagues that spending increases will fuel the inflation crisis, not end it."

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: ".@POTUS's plan to cancel student loan debt discriminates against the hardworking Americans who paid off their loans and leaves skilled trade workers, like plumbers and manufacturers, in the dust. Not to mention, this is another $360 billion log on the fire of inflation."

"Forgiving student loan debt on the taxpayers' dime sends the wrong message to younger Americans and penalizes Americans who paid back their loans in full or never had them. Proud to support a resolution to nullify @POTUS's plan to unilaterally "cancel" student loan debt"

"While inflation crushes the American people, Joe Biden wants to "forgive" student loan debt by transferring the burden to the taxpayers. My bill prohibits the President from abusing his authority to score a political victory by canceling student debt."
Rated 0% by National Education Association

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: Rated 6% by Common Cause

"At a time when restoring integrity in our elections is imperative, House Democrats want to undermine states’ existing election laws and remove voter ID, like we have in Wisconsin. #HR1 is a federal power grab that seeks to punish states that have commonsense election laws."
Voted against HR 4: "John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act of 2021"
Voted against HR 5746: "Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act"
